For the hobby of baking, the proposed skill assessment tool is a mobile application designed to track user progression. This app would allow users to log mastered recipes and specific baking techniques, while also maintaining a digital gallery of their finished products. To gamify the learning process, the app would award badges for achieving milestones, such as "Sourdough Specialist" or "Pastry Artisan." Additionally, it would include a community feature enabling peer and mentor feedback on uploaded photos of baked goods to help users refine their skills.
